question: At which specific sacred sites does installation and worship yield thousandfold merit?
premises: Installation and worship can yield thousandfold merit compared to other places.
Kanyā-tīrtha is named as one such site.
Nepal, Mahendra, and Amareśvara are also named as such sites.
inference: Therefore, installation and worship performed at Kanyā-tīrtha, in Nepal, at Mahendra, and at Amareśvara yield thousandfold merit.
uncertainties: The precise identification of Mahendra as a specific site is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: At Kanyā-tīrtha, in Nepal, at Mahendra, and at Amareśvara, installation and worship yield thousandfold merit.
